changes.from: Maker repository (poppy-project/poppy-humanoid): open-source 3D-printed humanoid, 25 Robotis Dynamixel actuators, about 60% of the BOM cost, full build 8,000-9,000 USD, Raspberry Pi 3/4 on-board, pypot Python library, GPL v3 / CC BY-SA. The project site (www.poppy-project.org, docs.poppy-project.org) returned HTTP 500 on 2026-11-17, so the 83 cm / 3.5 kg figures on its v1.0.2 page could not be re-opened and height/weight were left empty instead of carrying the aggregator's 840 mm / 3.5 kg values. Generation Robots is a distributor, not the designer. The 11,193 USD price was an aggregator conversion of a EUR list price and was removed.
